rules.name: schema-01-object-kind-audit
rules.sql: SELECT base_name AS object_name, CASE WHEN SUM(is_view) = COUNT(*) THEN 'VIEW' WHEN SUM(is_view) = 0 THEN 'TABLE' ELSE 'MIXED' END AS kind, COUNT(*) AS legacy_objects FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN RIGHT(table_name, 4) IN ('_bkr','_cfs','_cto','_ebo','_gpc','_grn','_og2','_ogp','_orm','_osg','_pf6','_pf9','_pg7','_pg8', '_qf1','_qf2','_qf3','_qf4','_qf5','_rba','_rbc','_rbh','_rmc','_rov','_stg','_tsy','_usg','_spc','_odr','_oad') THEN LEFT(table_name, CHAR_LENGTH(table_name) - 4) ELSE table_name END AS base_name, CASE WHEN table_type = 'VIEW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_view FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'dbsystemuat' ) t GROUP BY base_name ORDER BY base_name

SELECT t.table_name AS object_name, CASE WHEN t.table_type = 'VIEW' THEN 'VIEW' ELSE 'TABLE' END AS kind, CASE WHEN t.table_type = 'VIEW' THEN NULL ELSE c.reltuples::bigint END AS approx_rows FROM information_schema.tables t LEFT JOIN pg_class c ON c.relname = t.table_name AND c.relnamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace WHERE t.table_schema = 'opera' AND t.table_name NOT LIKE 'databasechangelog%' ORDER BY t.table_name

SELECT t.table_name AS object_name, (xpath('/row/c/text()', query_to_xml(format('select count(*) as c from %I.%I', t.table_schema, t.table_name), false, true, '')))[1]::text::bigint AS exact_rows FROM information_schema.tables t WHERE t.table_schema = 'opera' AND t.table_type = 'BASE TABLE' AND t.table_name IN (:m.object_name[]) ORDER BY exact_rows, t.table_name
